events.content: Create a single-file HTML page (/app/index.html) with all CSS and JavaScript inline and zero external assets. Never use image generation tools or models. Draw the scene with code (HTML, CSS, SVG, canvas or WebGL); embedded raster artwork is disallowed. Render a dark, atmospheric hero scene featuring a single, steaming bowl of vegan ramen as the sole visual focus. Make the dish feel alive and appetizing — with natural motion, ambient warmth, and interactive response to the mouse. Keep the scene pure (no UI, text, or menus), responsive on all screens, and respectful of prefers-reduced-motion.

# Anti-Slop: Frontend DON'Ts

What NOT to do when designing a UI or page. This is a filter, not a style; it never prescribes a look. Stacking several of the below is what reads as AI-made on sight. Adaptive, so if the user or another skill asks for something specific, do that instead; these are defaults, not overrides.

- purple / indigo / violet accent, or a purple-to-blue hero gradient (the top AI tell)
- `bg-clip-text` gradient headline text
- cream (`#faf8f4`) as the whole-page background
- aurora blobs / glowing colored shadows, or an identical glow on every card
- Inter everywhere, or Geist / Space Grotesk / Instrument Serif / Roboto / Arial as your only identity
- gray-400 / gray-500 body text
- one font weight and size throughout (no hierarchy)
- tracked all-caps micro-kickers above every section

- an 8+ word, 48px+ headline that says nothing
- bento grid for everything
- the same eyebrow-headline-3cards section repeated back to back
- `rounded-2xl`, or any single radius, on every element
- glassmorphism blur + border + shadow on every surface
- `hover:scale-105` lift on cards
- emoji as feature icons (🚀 ⚡ ✨ 🎯 💡)
- left-border accent cards, a colored border on a rounded element, or cards nested inside cards
- fade-up / slide-up on everything as it scrolls in
- motion that ignores `prefers-reduced-motion`

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Vegan Ramen</title>
<style>
  *{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
  html,body{width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#0a0705}
  body{position:fixed;inset:0}
  canvas{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;cursor:crosshair;touch-action:none}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="scene" aria-label="A steaming bowl of vegan ramen" role="img"></canvas>
<script>
(function(){
"use strict";
const canvas=document.getElementById('scene');
const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
const reduced=window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

let W=0,H=0,DPR=1,scale=1,cx=0,cy=0,bowlR=0;
let mouse={x:.5,y:.42,tx:.5,ty:.42,active:false};
let ripples=[];
let puffs=[];
let t0=performance.now();

function resize(){
  DPR=Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1,2);
  W=window.innerWidth; H=window.innerHeight;
  canvas.width=Math.round(W*DPR); canvas.height=Math.round(H*DPR);
  canvas.style.width=W+'px'; canvas.style.height=H+'px';
  ctx.setTransform(DPR,0,0,DPR,0,0);
  scale=Math.min(W,H);
  cx=W/2; cy=H*0.54;
  bowlR=Math.max(150,Math.min(scale*0.34,340));
  if(reduced) draw(0);
}
window.addEventListener('resize',resize);

function onMove(x,y){
  mouse.tx=x/W; mouse.ty=y/H; mouse.active=true;
}
canvas.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>onMove(e.clientX,e.clientY));
canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{
  onMove(e.clientX,e.clientY);
  if(reduced) return;
  const dx=e.clientX-cx, dy=(e.clientY-(cy-bowlR*0.18))*1.8;
  ripples.push({x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY,r:6,a:0.55,t:0});
  for(let i=0;i<10;i++) puffs.push(newPuff((Math.random()-0.5)*bowlR*0.7, true));
});
canvas.addEventListener('pointerleave',()=>{mouse.tx=.5;mouse.ty=.42;mouse.active=false;});

/* ---------- helpers ---------- */
function rr(x,y,w,h,r){
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x+r,y); ctx.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+h,r); ctx.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x,y+h,r);
  ctx.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y,r); ctx.arcTo(x,y,x+w,y,r); ctx.closePath();
}
function ellipse(x,y,rx,ry){ ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x,y,rx,ry,0,0,Math.PI*2); }

/* steam particles */
function newPuff(spreadX,burst){
  return {
    x: cx + (spreadX!==undefined?spreadX:(Math.random()-0.5)*bowlR*1.1),
    y: cy - bowlR*0.32 - Math.random()*10,
    r: 8+Math.random()*22,
    vy: -(0.25+Math.random()*0.55)*(burst?1.5:1),
    vx: (Math.random()-0.5)*0.18,
    life:0, max: 220+Math.random()*180,
    seed: Math.random()*Math.PI*2,
    burst: !!burst
  };
}
let steam=[];
function initSteam(){ steam=[]; for(let i=0;i<46;i++){ const p=newPuff(); p.life=Math.random()*p.max; p.y-=Math.random()*H*0.28; steam.push(p);} }

/* ---------- background ---------- */
function drawBackground(now){
  // deep warm darkness
  const g=ctx.createRadialGradient(cx + (mouse.x-.5)*40, H*0.34, 10, cx, cy, Math.max(W,H)*0.75);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#2b1a0e');
  g.addColorStop(0.35,'#1a1008');
  g.addColorStop(0.7,'#0d0805');
  g.addColorStop(1,'#060403');
  ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  // warm halo behind bowl (flickers gently, follows mouse slightly)
  const flick = reduced?0:Math.sin(now*0.0011)*0.04+Math.sin(now*0.0027)*0.02;
  const hx=cx+(mouse.x-.5)*70, hy=cy-bowlR*0.25;
  const halo=ctx.createRadialGradient(hx,hy,10,hx,hy,bowlR*2.15);
  halo.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,166,66,'+(0.20+flick)+')');
  halo.addColorStop(0.45,'rgba(214,110,36,'+(0.10+flick*0.6)+')');
  halo.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle=halo; ctx.fillRect(hx-bowlR*2.2,hy-bowlR*2.2,bowlR*4.4,bowlR*4.4);

  // faint floating dust / ember motes
  if(!reduced){
    ctx.save();
    for(let i=0;i<26;i++){
      const sx=(i*173.3)%W, sy=((i*97.7)%(H*0.7))+Math.sin(now*0.0004+i)*12;
      const a=0.05+0.05*Math.sin(now*0.001+i*1.7);
      ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,190,110,'+Math.max(0,a)+')';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sx,sy,1.1,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // table surface
  const tableY=cy+bowlR*0.52;
  const tg=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,tableY,0,H);
  tg.addColorStop(0,'#1e1209'); tg.addColorStop(0.12,'#170d06'); tg.addColorStop(1,'#080504');
  ctx.fillStyle=tg; ctx.fillRect(0,tableY,W,H-tableY);
  // table sheen under bowl
  const sheen=ctx.createRadialGradient(cx,tableY+8,10,cx,tableY+8,bowlR*1.5);
  sheen.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,150,60,0.13)'); sheen.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle=sheen; ellipse(cx,tableY+10,bowlR*1.5,bowlR*0.28); ctx.fill();
  // soft shadow
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.55)'; ellipse(cx,tableY+16,bowlR*0.92,bowlR*0.20); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.35)'; ellipse(cx,tableY+14,bowlR*0.65,bowlR*0.13); ctx.fill();
}

/* ---------- bowl & ramen ---------- */
function drawBowl(now){
  const R=bowlR;
  const rimY=cy-R*0.18;
  const parX=(mouse.x-.5)*6, parY=(mouse.y-.5)*4; // subtle parallax on food only

  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(parX*0.25, parY*0.25);

  // bowl body — dark ceramic with warm rim light
  const bodyGrad=ctx.createLinearGradient(cx-R,cy,cx+R,cy+R*0.6);
  bodyGrad.addColorStop(0,'#3a2320');
  bodyGrad.addColorStop(0.28,'#241413');
  bodyGrad.addColorStop(0.55,'#171010');
  bodyGrad.addColorStop(0.82,'#2c1c1a');
  bodyGrad.addColorStop(1,'#120c0b');
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(cx-R, rimY);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx-R, cy+R*0.42, cx-R*0.55, cy+R*0.62, cx-R*0.30, cy+R*0.64);
  ctx.lineTo(cx+R*0.30, cy+R*0.64);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx+R*0.55, cy+R*0.62, cx+R, cy+R*0.42, cx+R, rimY);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fillStyle=bodyGrad; ctx.fill();

  // foot
  ctx.fillStyle='#0f0a09';
  rr(cx-R*0.30, cy+R*0.62, R*0.60, R*0.075, 6); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,170,90,0.10)';
  ctx.fillRect(cx-R*0.30, cy+R*0.62, R*0.60, 2);

  // decorative band on bowl
  ctx.save();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(cx-R, rimY);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx-R, cy+R*0.42, cx-R*0.55, cy+R*0.62, cx-R*0.30, cy+R*0.64);
  ctx.lineTo(cx+R*0.30, cy+R*0.64);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx+R*0.55, cy+R*0.62, cx+R, cy+R*0.42, cx+R, rimY);
  ctx.closePath(); ctx.clip();
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(232,164,90,0.28)'; ctx.lineWidth=1.4;
  for(let i=0;i<3;i++){
    ctx.beginPath();
    const yy=cy+R*(0.18+i*0.09);
    ctx.moveTo(cx-R*0.95,yy);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx-R*0.4,yy+R*0.06,cx+R*0.4,yy+R*0.06,cx+R*0.95,yy);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  // left highlight / right warm bounce
  const hl=ctx.createLinearGradient(cx-R,0,cx-R*0.2,0);
  hl.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,220,180,0.14)'); hl.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,220,180,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle=hl; ctx.fillRect(cx-R,rimY,R*0.8,R*0.85);
  ctx.restore();

  ctx.restore();

  /* ----- broth surface ----- */
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(parX, parY);
  ellipse(cx,rimY,R*0.985,R*0.335);
  const broth=ctx.createRadialGradient(cx+(mouse.x-.5)*30, rimY-6, 10, cx, rimY, R);
  broth.addColorStop(0,'#f0a94e');
  broth.addColorStop(0.35,'#d97e2b');
  broth.addColorStop(0.7,'#b85a1e');
  broth.addColorStop(1,'#8a3d16');
  ctx.fillStyle=broth; ctx.fill();
  ctx.clip();

  // broth shimmer
  const shim = reduced?0.5:0.5+0.5*Math.sin(now*0.0016);
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,205,120,'+(0.10+shim*0.08)+')';
  ellipse(cx-R*0.25, rimY-R*0.08, R*0.55, R*0.13); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,235,190,0.16)';
  ellipse(cx+(mouse.x-.5)*R*0.5, rimY-R*0.05, R*0.28, R*0.06); ctx.fill();

  // gentle broth ripples (ambient)
  if(!reduced){
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,220,160,0.18)'; ctx.lineWidth=1.2;
    for(let i=0;i<3;i++){
      const ph=((now*0.00022)+(i/3))%1;
      ctx.globalAlpha=(1-ph)*0.5;
      ellipse(cx,rimY,R*0.3*ph+R*0.1,R*0.10*ph+R*0.03); ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha=1;
  }
  // click ripples
  for(const r of ripples){
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,240,200,'+Math.max(0,r.a)+')'; ctx.lineWidth=2;
    ellipse(r.x-cx+cx, r.y, r.r, r.r*0.34); ctx.stroke();
  }

  drawNoodles(now,R,rimY);
  drawToppings(now,R,rimY);
  drawChiliOil(now,R,rimY);

  ctx.restore();

  /* rim */
  ctx.save(); ctx.translate(parX,parY);
  ellipse(cx,rimY,R*0.995,R*0.345);
  ctx.strokeStyle='#4a2e28'; ctx.lineWidth=Math.max(5,R*0.045); ctx.stroke();
  ellipse(cx,rimY,R*0.995,R*0.345);
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,190,120,0.35)'; ctx.lineWidth=1.6; ctx.stroke();
  // rim highlight toward mouse
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(cx,rimY,R*0.995,R*0.345,0,Math.PI*(0.9+mouse.x*0.4),Math.PI*(1.35+mouse.x*0.4));
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,230,190,0.55)'; ctx.lineWidth=2.4; ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();

  drawChopsticks(now,R,rimY,parX,parY);
}

function drawNoodles(now,R,rimY){
  ctx.save();
  ctx.lineCap='round';
  const sway = reduced?0:Math.sin(now*0.0012)*1.6;
  // noodle mass base
  ctx.fillStyle='#e8c37a';
  ellipse(cx-R*0.05, rimY+R*0.01, R*0.62, R*0.19); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#dcb264';
  ellipse(cx+R*0.12, rimY+R*0.05, R*0.48, R*0.14); ctx.fill();
  // individual strands
  for(let i=0;i<34;i++){
    const a=(i/34)*Math.PI*2;
    const nx=cx+Math.cos(a)*R*(0.12+ (i%5)*0.075);
    const ny=rimY+Math.sin(a)*R*0.06 + (i%4)*3 + sway*(i%3-1)*0.4;
    ctx.strokeStyle= i%3===0 ? '#f2d492' : (i%3===1?'#e3bc6d':'#d4a856');
    ctx.lineWidth=2.6+ (i%3)*0.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(nx-R*0.16, ny);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(nx-R*0.05, ny-7, nx+R*0.05, ny+7, nx+R*0.16, ny-2);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  // lifted noodle swirl (center-left)
  ctx.strokeStyle='#f4d78f'; ctx.lineWidth=4;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(cx-R*0.30, rimY+R*0.02);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx-R*0.22, rimY-R*0.13+sway, cx-R*0.02, rimY-R*0.15+sway, cx+R*0.04, rimY-R*0.04);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle='#eac87e'; ctx.lineWidth=3;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(cx-R*0.26, rimY+R*0.04);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx-R*0.18, rimY-R*0.09+sway, cx+R*0.0, rimY-R*0.10+sway, cx+R*0.05, rimY-R*0.01);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
}

function leaf(x,y,s,rot,color){
  ctx.save(); ctx.translate(x,y); ctx.rotate(rot); ctx.scale(s,s);
  ctx.fillStyle=color;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0,-14); ctx.bezierCurveTo(10,-6,10,8,0,15); ctx.bezierCurveTo(-10,8,-10,-6,0,-14); ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(20,60,20,0.45)'; ctx.lineWidth=1.1;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0,-12); ctx.lineTo(0,13); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
}
function drawToppings(now,R,rimY){
  const bob = reduced?0:Math.sin(now*0.0018)*1.4;
  const bob2 = reduced?0:Math.sin(now*0.0018+1.4)*1.2;

  // bok choy
  leaf(cx-R*0.52, rimY-R*0.02+bob, 1.05,-0.5,'#3f7d2e');
  leaf(cx-R*0.44, rimY+R*0.05+bob2, 0.9,0.35,'#4c8f36');
  leaf(cx+R*0.48, rimY+R*0.03+bob, 0.95,0.6,'#3a752c');
  leaf(cx+R*0.56, rimY-R*0.04+bob2, 0.8,-0.4,'#4a8a34');

  // tofu cubes
  const tofu=[[-0.18,0.07,0.5],[0.02,0.10,-0.3],[0.22,0.05,0.25]];
  tofu.forEach((p,i)=>{
    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(cx+p[0]*R, rimY+p[1]*R+(i%2?bob:bob2)); ctx.rotate(p[2]);
    ctx.fillStyle='#f3e3c2'; rr(-13,-10,26,20,4); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#e8d0a0'; rr(-13,-10,26,7,4); ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(160,110,50,0.35)'; ctx.lineWidth=1; rr(-13,-10,26,20,4); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
  });

  // mushrooms (shiitake slices)
  [[-0.34,-0.06],[0.34,-0.07],[0.08,-0.09]].forEach((p,i)=>{
    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(cx+p[0]*R, rimY+p[1]*R+(i%2?bob2:bob)); ctx.rotate(i*0.5-0.4);
    ctx.fillStyle='#7a4a2e';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,0,17,10,0,Math.PI,0); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#c9a87a'; ctx.fillRect(-14,0,28,4);
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,230,190,0.5)'; ctx.lineWidth=1;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-8,-4); ctx.lineTo(-3,-7); ctx.moveTo(2,-5); ctx.lineTo(7,-8); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
  });

  // corn
  ctx.fillStyle='#f2c94c';
  [[-0.08,0.02],[0.14,0.11],[-0.42,0.10],[0.40,0.11]].forEach(p=>{
    for(let i=0;i<5;i++){ ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx+p[0]*R+(i%3-1)*6, rimY+p[1]*R+Math.floor(i/3)*6+bob, 3.2,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); }
  });

  // scallions
  ctx.fillStyle='#5da244';
  for(let i=0;i<16;i++){
    const sx=cx+(Math.sin(i*2.7)*R*0.55), sy=rimY+Math.cos(i*1.9)*R*0.10+bob;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(sx,sy,4.5,2.2,i,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.fillStyle='#7bc05e';
  for(let i=0;i<8;i++){
    const sx=cx+(Math.sin(i*3.4+1)*R*0.45), sy=rimY+Math.cos(i*2.3)*R*0.08;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(sx,sy,3.2,1.6,i,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  }

  // nori sheet at back
  ctx.save(); ctx.translate(cx+R*0.30, rimY-R*0.14+bob2); ctx.rotate(0.18);
  ctx.fillStyle='#16211a'; rr(-16,-26,32,42,3); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.06)'; rr(-16,-26,32,10,3); ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();

  // sesame
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,244,214,0.9)';
  for(let i=0;i<22;i++){
    const sx=cx+Math.sin(i*4.1)*R*0.52, sy=rimY+Math.cos(i*3.3)*R*0.11;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(sx,sy,2.4,1.1,i*1.3,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  }
}
function drawChiliOil(now,R,rimY){
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(198,52,28,0.55)';
  [[-0.22,-0.04,7],[0.28,0.02,9],[-0.02,0.13,6],[0.18,-0.10,5],[-0.48,0.04,6]].forEach(p=>{
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx+p[0]*R, rimY+p[1]*R, p[2], p[2]*0.55, 0,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  });
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(230,80,40,0.8)';
  for(let i=0;i<10;i++){ ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx+Math.sin(i*2.2)*R*0.5, rimY+Math.cos(i*1.7)*R*0.10, 1.6,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); }
}
function drawChopsticks(now,R,rimY,parX,parY){
  ctx.save(); ctx.translate(parX,parY);
  const lift = reduced?0:Math.sin(now*0.0012)*1.2;
  ctx.translate(cx+R*0.18, rimY-R*0.06+lift); ctx.rotate(-0.42);
  ctx.fillStyle='#5a3420';
  rr(-3,-R*0.52,6,R*0.62,3); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#6e4228'; rr(-3,-R*0.52,2.5,R*0.62,2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.translate(16,6); ctx.rotate(0.07);
  ctx.fillStyle='#4e2c1b'; rr(-3,-R*0.50,6,R*0.60,3); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#654026'; rr(-3,-R*0.50,2.5,R*0.60,2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

/* ---------- steam ---------- */
function drawSteam(now){
  const wind=(mouse.x-0.5)*0.9 + (mouse.active? (mouse.x-0.5)*0.5:0);
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
  for(const p of steam){
    const prog=p.life/p.max;
    const alpha=Math.sin(prog*Math.PI)*0.16*(p.burst?1.3:1);
    const sway=Math.sin(now*0.0012 + p.seed + p.life*0.02)*10*(0.4+prog);
    const x=p.x + sway + wind*prog*70;
    const y=p.y - prog*H*0.30;
    const r=p.r*(0.6+prog*1.9);
    const g=ctx.createRadialGradient(x,y,0,x,y,r);
    g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,246,235,'+alpha+')');
    g.addColorStop(0.55,'rgba(255,230,200,'+(alpha*0.45)+')');
    g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,230,200,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle=g;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x,y,r,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    // inner wisp
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,252,245,'+(alpha*0.5)+')';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x+sway*0.3,y-r*0.15,r*0.45,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}
function updateSteam(){
  for(let i=steam.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const p=steam[i]; p.life++;
    p.x+=p.vx + (mouse.x-0.5)*0.25;
    if(p.life>=p.max){ steam.splice(i,1); steam.push(newPuff()); }
  }
  for(let i=puffs.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const p=puffs[i]; p.life+=2.2; p.x+=p.vx; 
    if(p.life>=p.max) puffs.splice(i,1);
  }
}

/* ---------- vignette ---------- */
function drawVignette(){
  const v=ctx.createRadialGradient(cx,cy,scale*0.25,cx,cy,Math.max(W,H)*0.72);
  v.addColorStop(0,'rgba(0,0,0,0)'); v.addColorStop(0.75,'rgba(0,0,0,0.18)'); v.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0.62)');
  ctx.fillStyle=v; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  // warm top light shaft
  const shaft=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H*0.55);
  shaft.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,180,90,0.05)'); shaft.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,180,90,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle=shaft; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H*0.55);
}

function draw(now){
  // ease mouse
  mouse.x+=(mouse.tx-mouse.x)*0.045;
  mouse.y+=(mouse.ty-mouse.y)*0.045;
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
  drawBackground(now);
  drawBowl(now);
  // steam in front, merged puffs
  const all = steam.concat(puffs);
  const tmp=steam; 
  // draw puffs together with steam by temporarily merging
  const saved=steam;
  // simple: draw steam then puffs via same routine by swapping array reference is not possible; draw puffs manually
  drawSteam(now);
  if(puffs.length){
    ctx.save(); ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
    for(const p of puffs){
      const prog=p.life/p.max, alpha=Math.sin(Math.min(1,prog)*Math.PI)*0.22;
      const g=ctx.createRadialGradient(p.x,p.y-prog*60,0,p.x,p.y-prog*60,p.r*(1+prog));
      g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,246,235,'+alpha+')'); g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,246,235,0)');
      ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x,p.y-prog*60,p.r*(1+prog),0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }
  drawVignette();

  // ripples update
  for(let i=ripples.length-1;i>=0;i--){ const r=ripples[i]; r.r+=2.4; r.a-=0.012; r.t++; if(r.a<=0) ripples.splice(i,1); }
}

let rafId=null;
function loop(now){
  draw(now);
  updateSteam();
  rafId=requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

resize();
initSteam();
if(reduced){
  // single static, appetizing frame — no loop, no motion
  mouse.x=mouse.tx; mouse.y=mouse.ty;
  draw(1200);
} else {
  rafId=requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

// pause when hidden to save resources
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{
  if(reduced) return;
  if(document.hidden){ if(rafId) cancelAnimationFrame(rafId); rafId=null; }
  else if(!rafId){ rafId=requestAnimationFrame(loop); }
});
})();
</script>
</body>
